accountNotFound: No account found — please register on the web first
accountSwitchBlocked: You logged out of a different account recently — you can log in with a different account after {retryAt}
alreadyLinked: That account is already linked to another RepoNyx account
emailMismatch: That account uses a different email — link an account with the same email as your RepoNyx account
emailTaken: An account with this email already exists
emailUnavailable: We could not send the email — try again later
invalidBody: Check the form and try again
invalidToken: This link is invalid or expired
lastLoginMethod: You can't unlink your only way to sign in — set a password first
notConfigured: The service is not configured yet
oauthFailed: Could not sign you in with that provider — try again
rateLimitedRegister: Only one registration per IP every 24 hours — try again after {retryAt}
sessionExpired: Your session expired — please log in again
twoFactorRequired: Two-factor authentication is required — enter the code from your authenticator app
